svg.text: Choose whether the norm-design workflow should evaluate the current training state now. Choose wait or wake. … A plateau is not excused
as early learning or adaptation to a new norm.
You are the Reviewer. … diagnose how the active norm acts, evaluate where training stands against the environment's goal, and decide
whether to keep or change the norm … You write no design advice.
You are the Advisor. The active norm will be changed; advise what each requested candidate for task.aim should implement and why.
Whether to change is already decided. … without writing a norm, formula or constants.
You are the Designer. Implement the assigned reputation-norm task using the assessment and sandbox contracts. … Return exactly one
Choose the option whose measurements best meet the goal, from all rows including active. … Judge the supplied measurements, without
predicting future learning or choosing for exploration.
